ARC-001-DIAG-001-v1.0.title: C4 Container Diagram - AI Training Marketplace

controlFields.#1: Scalability and Elasticity: ECS auto-scaling for Platform API and Web App, horizontal scaling for Elasticsearch (3-node cluster)
controlFields.#2: Resilience and Fault Tolerance: Multi-AZ deployment (ECS, RDS), health checks, automated failover (RDS <60s), message queue retries
controlFields.#3: Multi-Tenancy and Data Isolation: Row-level security in Postgres (tenant_id column), separate schemas for providers/enterprises/learners
controlFields.#4: Interoperability and Open Standards: SAML 2.0 (Auth0, Azure AD, GOV.UK Verify), OAuth 2.0, SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI, REST APIs
controlFields.#5: Security by Design: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, JWT authentication, RBAC, MFA, secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager)
controlFields.#6: Observability and Monitoring: Datadog APM (request tracing), CloudWatch Logs (centralized logging), real-time dashboards, PagerDuty alerting
controlFields.#7: Loose Coupling: Microservices architecture (API, Payment Service, Recommendation Engine, Fraud Detection separate), message queue (async)
controlFields.#8: Data Sovereignty and Residency: AWS UK regions (eu-west-2 London), GOV.UK Pay (UK-only), UK GDPR compliance (data stored in UK)
controlFields.#9: Single Source of Truth: Postgres as primary database (authoritative source), read replicas for scaling (not authoritative), cache invalidation
controlFields.#10: Asynchronous Communication: RabbitMQ message queue (email, analytics, recommendations, quality scoring), event-driven architecture
controlFields.#15: Performance Optimization: Redis cache (<5ms latency), Elasticsearch (full-text search <200ms), database indexing, CDN (CloudFront)
controlFields.#16: High Availability: 99.9% uptime target (Multi-AZ ECS, RDS multi-AZ, RabbitMQ clustering, load balancing via ALB)
controlFields.#17: Automated Testing: Not shown in container diagram (testing is process, not container), but implied (CI/CD pipelines test all containers)
controlFields.#18: Maintainability: TypeScript for type safety (Web App, Platform API), Python for ML (scikit-learn standard), modular microservices
controlFields.#19: Responsible AI: ATRS documentation (Recommendation Engine, Quality Scoring), AI Playbook assessment, explainability ("Users like you...")
controlFields.#20: Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (Web Application), screen reader testing, keyboard navigation, color contrast

ARC-001-DIAG-002-v1.0.title: C4 Context Diagram - AI Training Marketplace

controlFields.#1: Scalability and Elasticity: ✅ Cloud-first approach implied (AWS infrastructure not shown at context level, visible in container diagram)
controlFields.#2: Resilience and Fault Tolerance: ✅ Multiple payment processors (GOV.UK Pay, Stripe) provide redundancy
controlFields.#3: Multi-Tenancy and Data Isolation: ✅ Multiple enterprise customers, individual learners, providers - multi-tenant architecture required
controlFields.#4: Interoperability and Open Standards: ✅ SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI - all open standards
controlFields.#5: Security by Design: ✅ External identity providers (GOV.UK Verify, Azure AD), PCI-DSS payment processors (Stripe)
controlFields.#6: Observability and Monitoring: ✅ Analytics integrations (Google Analytics, Mixpanel) for user behavior tracking
controlFields.#8: Data Sovereignty and Residency: ✅ GOV.UK Pay, GOV.UK Notify imply UK data residency for government users
controlFields.#10: Asynchronous Communication: ✅ Email services (GOV.UK Notify, SendGrid) are asynchronous
